entities.summary: Indrek Pertelson is an Estonian former international judoka. At the 2000 and 2004 Summer Olympics he won bronze medals in the men's Heavyweight (+100 kg) category. He has won the gold medal in the 1996 European Judo Championships in the Open class. Pertelson was born in Tallinn.
